about.text: with 10+ years in mobile, 7+ years in VR, and 3+ years in backend; experienced in engineering management, leading cross-functional teams of up to 9 engineers.
Ranked #1 in performance out of a 70-member department at HTC within my second year.
Actively leveraging AI-assisted workflows to steer development and solve complex engineering challenges.

bullets: Independently delivered multiple client projects end-to-end as a solo developer, spanning mobile apps, full-stack web development, web rendering, and mobile UI test automation with Appium (SDET).
Owned the full engagement lifecycle single-handedly — requirements scoping, estimation, architecture, implementation, and handoff.
Professional Development: Studied product strategy, skill development, and communication, including The Lean Startup, Peak, Atomic Habits, and We Need to Talk.

Led a 9-person cross-functional team spanning App, Frontend, Backend, and DevOps, owning end-to-end delivery of the company's flagship product from planning to production while integrating core platforms with AI technologies.
Built a full-stack, T-shaped engineering culture and standardized Scrum practices across the department.

Championed AI-assisted software development, integrating AI coding agents (GitHub Copilot, Gemini) into the team's engineering workflow with clear code review and quality standards to accelerate product iteration.
Architected core systems — event buses, job queues, and CPU/GPU resource allocation — reducing monthly cloud infrastructure costs by 87%.
Led a 4-person platform team across rendering and app development, delivering a core rendering-layer SDK adopted by external partners and internal systems.
